name: Nothing But The Truth
label: Quest
description: Nothing But The Truth: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: We need to operate with a certain amount of discretion. After all, it's not like you're going to waltz in there and convince the fool to drink Faustin's concoction here, right?

But if there's one thing those humans cannot deny it's the booze. I'll take Faustin's serum and mix it into this ale. I guarantee the poor sap will show no reluctance when it comes to chug-a-lugging a brew.
Make haste to Stonard in the Swamp of Sorrows, friend. And keep our little mission nice and quiet...

clips.title: Progress
paras: Please have mercy on me! I have information that goes beyond alliance boundaries. While I am no sympathizer of the Horde, there is political treachery going on that must be revealed!

clips.title: Completion
paras: A drink for me? How kind. It's been days since they've allowed me to drink. Let me drink this down and then I'll tell you what I've learned....
